title: e2e: the MSW test in console-rendering.spec passes when the worker is absent (it is absent), and 18 of 22 live specs run nowhere in CI — delete the vacuous test and make the four live specs count
body:
Ruled: 6435339772 · letter Q1 A · Q2 no · Q3 B · 2026-10-27T06:33Z

Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

CI 的 e2e 是对无后端的 `vite preview` 跑 10 个 spec / 44 个用例（启动指示、SPA 回退、几何 pin），没有任何一条端到端地把 console 接到一个（哪怕是 mock 的）后端。`e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts` 里「产物包含 MSW worker」的测试在文件缺失时静默返回——而树里本来就没有 `mockServiceWorker.js`（console / app-shell 0 处 msw）。真正的端到端在 `e2e/live/`：22 个 spec，CI 只跑 4 个且是信息性车道（最近 10/12 绿，1.4 分钟），其余 18 个在任何 CI 都不跑。建议：删空测试；把 4 个 live spec 升为 required（或停掉每 PR 的 487 次信息性运行只留每日）。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; Actions API window 10-17 to 10-24)

- CI e2e = `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium` over `playwright.config.ts` (`testDir ./e2e`, `testIgnore **/live/**`), web server = `vite preview` of the console, no backend: 10 files, 44 tests — boot indicator 4, SPA fallback / bundle 404s 8, CSS geometry pins (sidebar 6, header widths 16, tile 1, toast 4), cascading options 1; `page.route` mocking in 2 files only.
- The vacuous test: `e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts`, "should include the MSW service worker in the build output", returns silently when the file is missing or is HTML and asserts only when it is already JS. `git ls-files 'apps/console/public/*' | grep -c mockServiceWorker` → 0; `git grep -l msw -- 'apps/console/**' 'packages/app-shell/**'` → 0 source hits (`msw` is declared in root, plugin-form, plugin-grid with 0 imports — see the zero-consumer card objectui#13453).
- Live: 22 specs in `e2e/live/`; the CI allowlist `test:e2e:live:ci` in the root `package.json` names 4; `live-e2e.yml` is "(informational)", 487 runs in 7 days, 1.4 min median (Playwright 19 s, backend start 10 s), green 10 of the latest 12; the other 18 specs run only on a developer machine.
- Unit side: 6 `apps/console` tests render `App`, none through a network layer.
- Business reason: a change that breaks the console against the real backend's first screen is caught today only by a non-blocking lane; the required e2e asserts pixels, not behaviour. NORTH-STAR "做出来的是什么 … 过了验证才算做好".
- Dedup (`mockServiceWorker|msw|live-e2e|test:e2e:live|console-rendering.spec`): 9 hits, 0 open; closed and related: objectui#13104 (eleven live specs stale or red), objectstack-ai/objectui#13132, objectstack-ai/objectui#12649, objectstack-ai/objectui#12674, objectstack-ai/objectui#12676, objectstack-ai/objectui#12737.

## Task

- [ ] Delete the MSW test (and, with objectui#13453, the unused `msw` declarations and `public/mockServiceWorker.js`).
- [ ] Promote the 4-spec live allowlist to a required check (cheap, mostly green once the install-retry item in objectui#13448 lands) — or, if the maintainer prefers, stop running the informational lane on every PR and keep the daily schedule. Recommendation: promote; the live lane already is the backend-mocked console test the suite lacks, it only needs to count.
- [ ] Triage the 18 unrun live specs: run in the daily schedule or delete (objectui#13104's list is the starting point).

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat; the workflow half is a governed surface (authorised approval before landing). Effort S.
